Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY review. The PR changes posted G-code.

What looks good:

- The option is off by default. Unsupported stock produces a comment.
- The stock parameters have a separate app module. The Klartext post accepts them.
- The trial merge with upstream main was clean. No PR source file changed during this review.

Requested before merge:

1. **Correct the bar origin reference.** `assets/posts/fanuc.cps:614` calculates G1900 K from the lower end of the bar. [Fanuc B-63874EN/05, printed page 193, PDF page 215](https://www.cnc.uk.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Manual-Guide-Milling-and-Turning-Manual.pdf#page=215) defines K from the end face. The diagram shows the distance from the work origin to the positive-Z end face. Thus, use `StockZTop - OriginZ` for this bar. The PR's top-face-origin example must give `G1900 D60. L30. K0.`. A local CLI run gives `G1900 D60. L30. K30.`. The diagram implies that this value moves the simulated blank by its full length. Update the bar test, the NC fixture, and the decision record. Add a case with the origin below the top face. Refuse a case that needs a negative K, which this blank definition does not accept. The current passing test preserves the wrong value.
2. **Run the required heavy lanes and record the results.** `crates/app/src/posting.rs:1310` changes app posting. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects all app heavy targets: 204 steps, including the release build. The PR body reports only the quick gate and clippy. Upstream main's current `AGENTS.md`, under "Heavy lanes at review", requires the reached lanes to pass. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the corrected head. Add the lane names and results to the PR body. I did not run these lanes after I found item 1. A dry run is not a pass.

- `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Heavy lanes: not run. Item 2 remains open.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -j 16 -p camcraft-post --test fanuc_mgi_blank`: 10 passed. This separate run covers both new NC fixtures under `docs/tester-kits/fanuc-mgi-blank/`.
- No importer code or shared `testdata/` directory changed. The extra kernel importer suites do not apply.

Mutations:

- Removed the WCS yaw guard in a script copy under `/tmp`. The unsupported-stock assertion failed. The original script passed.
- Removed the bar-centre guard in a script copy under `/tmp`. The offset-bar assertion failed. The original script passed.
- Both checks used the local `post` CLI and the PR's recorded input values. No tracked source file changed.

Golden and fixture check:

- No existing golden moved.
- I checked every line of both new NC fixtures. The bar fixture has the K error in item 1. The box fixture matches the stated stock.
- No `crates/ui` file changed. The screenshot requirement does not apply.
